I recently started using your Honey and I really like the concept and how it feels on the skin once applied, it’s clear a lot of care went into this product. I just wanted to share a small suggestion that might enhance the experience even more.
 The jar is quite small, which makes it a bit tricky to scoop out, especially without getting product under the nails. A small spatula or applicator would make a big difference. Also, I noticed it takes a long time to warm it up and melt between the fingers before applying. Perhaps a slightly softer texture could make it even more user-friendly. Also, a discount would be great so I can buy it for other family members and friends to give it a try.

I used the original tallow & honey balm for 3 nights on my face. Woke up to 2 huge pimples (beside the nose and right temple) and greasy face , which didn't happen the nights before. I stopped using the balm on the face. Currently using it every other day on hands only as a moisturiser. I don't think I'll use it again on the face as I like my face clean and clear. I gave one jar to my cousin, but his skin didn't accept the tallow either after 2 nights.
 This tallow is all natural by the ingredients list, but for the oils used it doesn't mention if those are essential oils, extracts or tinctures, if are certified organic + pesticide free, or in which percentage.
 I, personally, don't think there's any point in adding so many oils to this tallow, because that's clearly only for the scent purpose. 
 I know that tallow is highly comedogenic, but I had higher expectations after reading all great reviews and I thought it might be a very light formula that could work with my mixed skin. 

 I'm writing this honest review here instead of sending an email to the company as requested, because I'm trying to help other women out there with similar skin like mine not waste their money, time and skin condition.

Hi there. So let me start by saying I do love your product, however my most recent purchase has disappointed me. The first time I ordered was a while ago and I bought 3 jars of tallow for myself and my daughters. We all loved them. So I recently ordered another jar for myself and I can’t say the same about this one. When I apply it there are tons of little hard balls that won’t dissolve easily and some won’t dissolve at all. When I apply it to my face these little balls get stuck in my eyebrows and hairline etc which is annoying especially if you don’t notice and leave the house like it. 
 Do you have any reason why this is happening with this jar. It’s not due to extreme cold, I live in Southern California and it’s warm most of the time here.  

 Thanks in advance 

 Jo
